method: measure_honesty.py — same reports, slugs and judge rubrics as the M9/POST_OPS audits; no report regeneration, so the candidate sets are identical and the numbers are comparable
caveats: The claim-chart post-verification figure is 0 of 5 cells. Five cells cannot support a rate estimate.
The cell verifier and the auditing judge are both gemini-2.5-flash with similar prompts, so they share failure modes; the true residual false-positive rate is very likely above zero.
Verification removed 7 of 12 coverage cells rather than correcting them. The chart now asserts far less, which is the intended outcome, not a recall improvement.

Of the rationale improvement from 26.3% to 7.5%, nearly all is attributable to fixing the generator/judge text desync (26.3% -> 7.9% with the generator unchanged). The span+bigram grounding change is justified by a controlled length-stability test and a regression test, NOT by a measured drop on this 40-item sample.
